run_marching_cubes_naive: run the marching cubes algorithm on a batch of 3D scalar fields to extract mesh vertices and faces
create_Cube_instance: create a Cube instance with a bottom front left vertex coordinate and optional edge spacing
call_Cube_get_index: call get_index on a Cube to compute its 0-255 lookup index from volume data and isolevel
run_polygonise: run polygonise on a single Cube to extract its triangle vertices and faces from volume data
call_get_edge_indices: call get_edge_indices to decode which of the 12 cube edges are intersected from a bitmask
